summary: Iteration 19 — Full backend + frontend QA of 'Mi cobertura médica' + redesigned 'Gastos' personal financial manager + Plus tools (AI extract, financial reports, dossier ZIP, finance permissions, finance block in /api/process). Backend (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_amodo_iter19_finance.py): 28 passed, 1 skipped (new-user register endpoint returned non-200 on this env), 0 failed. Verified: POST /api/coverages creates private insurance + IMSS simultaneously, update via POST with id, archived flag, DELETE soft, missing type -> 422. /api/finance/expenses CRUD with all calc deltas as required: (a) fully paid own -> net=amount, pending_pay=0, status 'Pagado'; (b) direct insurer payment -> paid_own unchanged, net unchanged, direct = amount; (c) partial payments -> pending_pay = total - sum; (d) claim requested does NOT change net; (e) authorized partial -> net unchanged, pending_receive = authorized; (f) two deposits -> received = sum, net decreases by sum, pending_receive = authorized - received; history has one entry per manual status change; (g) supports reduce net; (h) empty title -> 422; (i) legacy POST /api/records/expenses with status 'Pagado' -> paid_own = amount. GET list returns items[] each with calc{total,paid_own,direct,pending_pay,requested,authorized,received,pending_receive,supports,net} and totals. Permissions: default caregiver gets 403 on /finance/expenses, /records/expenses, /coverages (all with owner_id=<patient>); PUT /finance/permissions/{caregiver_id} {perms:{add:true}} returns view=true automatically; caregiver with 'add' can POST a new expense for the patient but cannot PUT (403, needs 'edit') and still cannot see /coverages (403). Documents: upload PNG (1x1) with ref_type=expense returns no 'path'; unsupported mime -> 422; GET list has no path; POST /{id}/link returns /api/finance-file/{code}, GET on that URL without auth returns the file bytes; invalid code -> 404. Plus reports: invalid type -> 422; financial -> %PDF Content-Type application/pdf; dossier -> application/zip containing '00-resumen.pdf'; non-Plus caregiver -> 403. Plus extract: consent:false -> 422; non-Plus -> 403 before file lookup. GET /api/process?today=<today>&days=30 includes 'finance' block with totals and recent when expenses exist. Frontend (390x844, demo patient via /welcome -> welcome-demo-patient-button): /coverage shows coverage-screen; coverage-add opens the type sheet with 14 coverage-type-* testIDs including Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores, Seguro médico privado, Seguro colectivo empresarial, etc. An existing seeded coverage card shows 'Ver y editar' and 'Gastos' actions. /finances renders finances-screen with finances-net hero (shows 'Desembolso neto actual', 'Gasto final estimado · no garantizado'), 6 finances-tile-* tiles (Gastos registrados, Pagado por ti o tu red, Pagos pendientes, Pago directo de terceros, Reembolso solicitado, Apoyos recibidos), finances-months WeekBars, finances-categories HBars, finances-list, finances-add button. Chips row: finances-filters (opens finances-filters-sheet with 31 filter chips), finances-coverage, finances-perms (opens finances-perms-sheet with 8 switches = view/add/edit/coverages/docs/attach/claims/reports), finances-reports (opens finances-report-sheet with chips). finances-net tap opens finances-info-sheet. /expense-form: expense-title, expense-amount, expense-category, expense-date render; folds expense-fold-payments / expense-fold-sources / expense-fold-claim / expense-fold-more all present; expense-fold-insurance only appears conditionally under the claim fold (component source confirms it is rendered as 'Deducible y coaseguro'). expense-fold-payments -> expense-add-payments -> expense-entry-amount + expense-entry-source-own + expense-entry-source-direct + expense-entry-save are all wired. After saving a new expense the form reopens in edit mode (router.replace) with expense-fold-docs visible. Caregiver (welcome-demo-caregiver-button) opening /finances?owner_id=<patient> renders a clean error state: 'No pudimos cargar esto — Esta persona no te ha dado permiso para esto — Reintentar', no crash, no React Native red screen. No console errors other than the carried-over expo-notifications web warning. End state: all TEST_ expenses/coverages created during pytest were deleted in the module fixture teardown; finance permissions on demo@amodo.app for the seeded caregiver are all false; demo@amodo.app plan.tier='plus' preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/finance.py:calc() correctly treats requested/authorized refunds as NOT affecting net until deposits are recorded (received only reduces net). Verified by pytest test_claim_lifecycle across the three stages (requested -> authorized partial -> deposits).

backend/finance.py:_expense() appends to claim.history only when status actually changes vs previous value — matches spec 'one entry per manual status change' (no duplicate entries when editing other fields).

backend/finance.py:create_expense() returns clean(rec) WITHOUT the 'calc' dict (POST response); only GET /finance/expenses/{id} and GET /finance/expenses include calc. This is not a bug but a slight inconsistency vs update_expense() which does return it. Front-end code in finances.tsx already re-fetches via the list endpoint, so no user impact. Worth noting.

backend/finance.py:access() short-circuits on owner_id == user['id'] (returns before touching db.links), and otherwise requires an active link AND the specific perm — correctly denying unlinked users (403) and caregivers whose permission flag is false (403). Verified: default (all false) blocks /finance/expenses, /records/expenses and /coverages.
backend/finance.py:set_permissions() enforces view=true whenever any other perm is on. Verified: PUT {perms:{add:true}} returns {add:true, view:true, ...}.

backend/finance.py:list_docs() strips 'path' from the response; upload_doc() also strips 'path'. Private storage is only accessible via a short-lived /api/finance-file/{code}, and finance_file() does NOT require Authorization (public-by-token) — correct for allowing in-app preview without re-auth and expires in 5 minutes.

backend/finance.py:extract_doc() requires Plus via Depends(require_plus) (returns 403 before any file lookup for non-Plus users) AND requires explicit consent=true (422). It also calls use_ai/refund_ai correctly on failure.

backend/finance.py:finance_report() uses Depends(require_plus) (403 for non-Plus) and finance_download() re-checks is_plus(user) at download time, so a cancelled Plus mid-flight yields 404. Correct for Plus-gated flow.

backend/finance.py:compact() returns None when there are no expenses — consumed by process.py:process_data() which assigns d['finance'] = await compact(...). Verified: /api/process includes 'finance' with totals/recent for the demo patient.
backend/finance.py is 536 lines — close to the 700-line ceiling but still within limits. Future splits (coverages / docs / reports) would be prudent if more scope lands here.

frontend/app/finances.tsx and expense-form.tsx are both under 230 lines each — very well scoped. All interactive elements (hero, tiles, chips, filter chips, perm switches, report chips, add button, expense folds, payment entries, delete) carry testID consistent with the spec.

frontend/app/coverage.tsx: coverage-add opens a sheet exposing coverage-type-sheet-backdrop / coverage-type-sheet / coverage-type-sheet-close as the sheet wrapper + 11 coverage-type-<Name> entries. The spec uses coverage-type-<type> as the convention — present and selectable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 non-skipped pytest cases pass; 1 skipped — unrelated register endpoint)

seed_data_creation: pytest module fixture created and deleted TEST_-prefixed expenses, coverages, and docs on demo@amodo.app, then reset all finance permissions on the patient's active caregiver link to false. End-state /api/finance/expenses contains 0 TEST_ titles, /api/coverages contains 0 TEST_ names, /api/finance/permissions shows view/add/edit/coverages/docs/attach/claims/reports all false for the seeded caregiver. demo@amodo.app plan.tier='plus' preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Token in web localStorage is a JSON-quoted string under key 'amodo_token' — read via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('amodo_token')). POST /api/finance/expenses returns clean(rec) WITHOUT 'calc' — re-fetch via GET /api/finance/expenses/{id} or /api/finance/expenses to get derived amounts. /api/process requires 'today' query param (YYYY-MM-DD); only days ∈ {7,30,90} are accepted. For caregiver no-permission check, use the linked seeded caregiver (acompanante@amodo.app) and read patient_id from GET /api/network -> as_caregiver[0].patient_id. The pre-existing seed includes a private-insurance coverage card and some expenses on the patient; preserve them on teardown (only delete TEST_-prefixed items).
rca_of_issue: n/a — no regressions found. All iteration 19 features (Mi cobertura médica, redesigned Gastos with partial payments / direct-insurer / claim lifecycle / deposits / supports / supports-reduce-net / legacy-record compatibility, per-companion finance permissions with default-nothing, private documents with temporary public links, AI extract gated by Plus+consent, PDF / ZIP reports, finance block in Mi proceso, caregiver no-perm empty state) are implemented and work end-to-end.
